ebitda_definition.ebitda_base_definition: Consolidated Net Income for such period, plus certain adjustments
ebitda_definition.ebitda_base_citation: "Consolidated EBITDA" means, for any period, Consolidated Net Income for such period, plus

addbacks.description: consolidated interest expense for such period (including imputed interest expense in respect of Capital Lease Obligations)
addbacks.citation: consolidated interest expense for such period (including imputed interest expense in respect of Capital Lease Obligations)

addbacks.description: provision for Taxes based on income, profits or losses, including foreign withholding Taxes during such period
addbacks.citation: provision for Taxes based on income, profits or losses, including foreign withholding Taxes during such period

addbacks.description: all amounts attributable to depreciation and amortization for such period
addbacks.citation: all amounts attributable to depreciation and amortization for such period

addbacks.description: any extraordinary, unusual or non-recurring losses, charges or expenses for such period, determined on a consolidated basis in accordance with GAAP
addbacks.cap_or_limit: 25.00% of Consolidated EBITDA for such Test Period
addbacks.citation: any extraordinary, unusual or non-recurring losses, charges or expenses for such period, determined on a consolidated basis in accordance with GAAP; provided that, the aggregate amount of any such unusual and non-recurring losses, charges or expenses in respect of any Test Period shall not exceed 25.00% of Consolidated EBITDA for such Test Period

addbacks.description: any Non-Cash Charges for such period
addbacks.citation: any Non-Cash Charges for such period

addbacks.description: any losses attributable to early extinguishment of Indebtedness or obligations under any Hedging Agreement
addbacks.citation: any losses attributable to early extinguishment of Indebtedness or obligations under any Hedging Agreement

addbacks.description: Pro Forma Adjustments in connection with Permitted Acquisitions
addbacks.cap_or_limit: 25.00% of Consolidated EBITDA in respect of such Test Period (combined with category viii)
addbacks.citation: Pro Forma Adjustments in connection with Permitted Acquisitions

addbacks.description: nonrecurring integration or restructuring expenses in connection with acquisitions or restructurings other than in the ordinary course of business (including severance costs, retention payments, change of control bonuses, relocation expenses and similar expenses)
addbacks.cap_or_limit: 25.00% of Consolidated EBITDA in respect of such Test Period (combined with category vii)
addbacks.citation: nonrecurring integration or restructuring expenses in connection with acquisitions or restructurings other than in the ordinary course of business (including severance costs, retention payments, change of control bonuses, relocation expenses and similar expenses)

addbacks.description: one-time out-of-pocket transactional costs and expenses relating to Permitted Acquisitions, Investments outside the ordinary course of business, incurrence of Indebtedness (including any amendment or refinancing thereof), issuance of Equity Interests and Dispositions (regardless of whether consummated), including legal fees, advisory fees, and upfront financing fees
addbacks.citation: one-time out-of-pocket transactional costs and expenses relating to Permitted Acquisitions, Investments outside the ordinary course of business, incurrence of Indebtedness (including any amendment or refinancing thereof), issuance of Equity Interests and Dispositions (regardless of whether consummated), including legal fees, advisory fees, and upfront financing fees

addbacks.description: unrealized losses during such period attributable to the application of "mark-to-market" accounting in respect of any Convertible Notes or Hedging Agreement other than those relating to foreign currencies
addbacks.citation: unrealized losses during such period attributable to the application of "mark-to-market" accounting in respect of any Convertible Notes or Hedging Agreement other than those relating to foreign currencies

addbacks.description: non-recurring fees and expenses incurred during such period in connection with the Transactions
addbacks.citation: non-recurring fees and expenses incurred during such period in connection with the Transactions

addbacks.description: upfront fees or charges or losses arising from any Receivables Securitization for such period
addbacks.citation: upfront fees or charges or losses arising from any Receivables Securitization for such period

addbacks.description: any other amounts for such period comparable to or in the nature of interest under any Receivables Securitization, and losses on dispositions of Receivables and related assets in connection with any Receivables Securitization for such period
addbacks.citation: any other amounts for such period comparable to or in the nature of interest under any Receivables Securitization, and losses on dispositions of Receivables and related assets in connection with any Receivables Securitization for such period

exclusions_or_deductions.description: Extraordinary, unusual or non-recurring gains for such period, determined on a consolidated basis in accordance with GAAP
exclusions_or_deductions.citation: any extraordinary, unusual or non-recurring gains for such period, determined on a consolidated basis in accordance with GAAP

exclusions_or_deductions.description: Non-cash gains for such period, including any gains attributable to the early extinguishment of Indebtedness
exclusions_or_deductions.citation: any non-cash gains for such period, including any gains attributable to the early extinguishment of Indebtedness

exclusions_or_deductions.description: Any net income Tax benefit for such period determined on a consolidated basis in accordance with GAAP
exclusions_or_deductions.citation: any net income Tax benefit for such period determined on a consolidated basis in accordance with GAAP

exclusions_or_deductions.description: Any gains attributable to the early extinguishment of obligations under any Hedging Agreement other than those relating to foreign currencies
exclusions_or_deductions.citation: any gains attributable to the early extinguishment of obligations under any Hedging Agreement other than those relating to foreign currencies

exclusions_or_deductions.description: Unrealized gains during such period attributable to the application of "mark-to-market" accounting in respect of any Convertible Notes or Hedging Agreement
exclusions_or_deductions.citation: unrealized gains during such period attributable to the application of "mark-to-market" accounting in respect of any Convertible Notes or Hedging Agreement

exclusions_or_deductions.description: The cumulative effect of any changes in GAAP or accounting principles applied by management
exclusions_or_deductions.citation: the cumulative effect of any changes in GAAP or accounting principles applied by management

exclusions_or_deductions.description: Cash payments or other reversals made with respect to any Non-Cash Charges added back in prior periods
exclusions_or_deductions.citation: any cash payment or other reversals made with respect to any Non-Cash Charges added back in computing Consolidated EBITDA for any prior period pursuant to clause (a)(v) above (or that would have been added back had this Agreement been in effect during such prior period) shall be subtracted in computing Consolidated EBITDA for the period in which such cash payment or reversal is made

ebitda_definition.overall_addback_cap: 25.00% of Consolidated EBITDA for categories (vii) and (viii) combined
ebitda_definition.overall_addback_cap_citation: the aggregate amount of all amounts under clauses (vii) and (viii) that increase Consolidated EBITDA in any Test Period (including, for avoidance of doubt, in connection with any calculation made hereunder on a Pro Forma Basis) shall not exceed, and shall be limited to, 25.00% of Consolidated EBITDA in respect of such Test Period (calculated after giving effect to such adjustments and with no carryover of unused amounts into any subsequent period)

covenant_levels.citation: in an unlimited amount if the Total Net Leverage Ratio at the time such payments are made, calculated on a Pro Forma Basis giving effect to such payments, is equal to or less than 3.50 to 1.00

restricted_payments.general_restriction: Yes. The Borrower will not declare or make, or agree to pay or make, directly or indirectly, any Restricted Payment, or incur any obligation (contingent or otherwise) to do so, except as specifically permitted by enumerated exceptions.
restricted_payments.general_restriction_citation: The Borrower will not, and will not permit any Restricted Subsidiary to, declare or make, or agree to pay or make, directly or indirectly, any Restricted Payment, or incur any obligation (contingent or otherwise) to do so, except that:

permitted_baskets.conditions: Dividends with respect to Equity Interests payable solely in additional Equity Interests permitted hereunder
permitted_baskets.citation: the Borrower may declare and pay dividends with respect to its Equity Interests payable solely in additional Equity Interests permitted hereunder

permitted_baskets.conditions: Ratably to holders of such Equity Interests or its Equity Interests of the relevant class
permitted_baskets.citation: any Restricted Subsidiary may declare and pay dividends or make other distributions with respect to its capital stock, partnership or membership interests or other similar Equity Interests, or make other Restricted Payments in respect of its Equity Interests, in each case ratably to the holders of such Equity Interests or its Equity Interests of the relevant class, as the case may be

permitted_baskets.conditions: Equity Interests transferred in satisfaction of a portion of the exercise price of such options
permitted_baskets.citation: the Borrower may purchase or otherwise acquire Equity Interests upon the exercise of stock options if such Equity Interests are transferred in satisfaction of a portion of the exercise price of such options

permitted_baskets.conditions: Cash payments in lieu of fractional shares in connection with exercise or conversion of warrants, options, Convertible Notes or other securities
permitted_baskets.citation: the Borrower may make cash payments in lieu of the issuance of fractional shares representing insignificant interests in the Borrower in connection with the exercise or conversion, as applicable, of warrants, options, Convertible Notes or other securities convertible into or exchangeable for Equity Interests in the Borrower

permitted_baskets.conditions: Pursuant to and in accordance with stock option plans or other benefit plans or agreements approved by the Borrower's board of directors for directors, officers or employees of the Borrower and the Subsidiaries
permitted_baskets.dollar_cap: $10,000,000 per fiscal year with carryover of unused amounts to next fiscal year
permitted_baskets.citation: the Borrower may make Restricted Payments, not exceeding $10,000,000 in the aggregate during any fiscal year (with any unused amount of such base amount from any fiscal year available for use in the next succeeding fiscal year following the use of the base amount permitted by this clause (v) in such succeeding fiscal year), pursuant to and in accordance with stock option plans or other benefit plans or agreements approved by the Borrower's board of directors for directors, officers or employees of the Borrower and the Subsidiaries

permitted_baskets.conditions: During any fiscal year, aggregate amount not to exceed the greater of two amounts
permitted_baskets.dollar_cap: Greater of $75,000,000 or 37.50% of Consolidated EBITDA for prior fiscal year, with carryover for one year of up to 50.00% of unused amounts
permitted_baskets.citation: the Borrower may effect Share Repurchases during any fiscal year in an aggregate amount not to exceed the greater of (x) $75,000,000 and (y) 37.50% of Consolidated EBITDA for the prior fiscal year (with carryover for one year of up to 50.00% of unused amounts)
the Borrower may make additional cash Restricted Payments in an aggregate cumulative amount of $75,000,000

permitted_baskets.basket_name: Additional Cash Restricted Payments - Available Amount or Leverage Based
permitted_baskets.conditions: No Default shall have occurred and be continuing or would result therefrom, and either (x) Borrower in Pro Forma Compliance with Section 6.12 covenant or (y) Total Net Leverage Ratio equal to or less than 3.50 to 1.00
permitted_baskets.dollar_cap: Up to Available Amount if condition (x) met; unlimited if condition (y) met
permitted_baskets.leverage_test: Total Net Leverage Ratio equal to or less than 3.50 to 1.00
permitted_baskets.citation: the Borrower may make additional cash Restricted Payments, so long as at the time each such Restricted Payment is made no Default shall have occurred and be continuing or would result therefrom, (x) in an amount not in excess of (and which shall utilize) the Available Amount at the time such Restricted Payments are made; provided that, the Borrower is at such time in Pro Forma Compliance with the covenant set forth in Section 6.12 after giving effect to such Restricted Payments, and (y) in an unlimited amount if the Total Net Leverage Ratio at the time such Restricted Payments are made, calculated on a Pro Forma Basis giving effect to such Restricted Payments, is equal to or less than 3.50 to 1.00

permitted_baskets.conditions: During period from 2024 Restatement Effective Date to Revolving Maturity Date
permitted_baskets.citation: during the period commencing on the 2024 Restatement Effective Date and ending on the Revolving Maturity Date, the Borrower may repurchase up to $300,000,000 in aggregate amount of outstanding shares of its common stock (including by way of tender offers, open market purchases, derivatives or other structured stock buyback transactions) pursuant to an accelerated share repurchase program or otherwise

permitted_baskets.conditions: Pursuant to terms of call spread, capped call or similar arrangement entered into in connection with issuance of Convertible Notes
permitted_baskets.citation: the Borrower may repurchase Equity Interests pursuant to the terms of or make other payments in respect of a call spread, capped call or similar arrangement entered into in connection with the issuance of Convertible Notes

restricted_payments.builder_basket: Yes. The Borrower may make additional cash Restricted Payments in an unlimited amount if the Total Net Leverage Ratio at the time such Restricted Payments are made, calculated on a Pro Forma Basis giving effect to such Restricted Payments, is equal to or less than 3.50 to 1.00. Additionally, the Borrower may use the Available Amount for Restricted Payments so long as no Default shall have occurred and be continuing or would result therefrom, and the Borrower is in Pro Forma Compliance with the Section 6.12 covenant.
restricted_payments.builder_basket_citation: the Borrower may make additional cash Restricted Payments, so long as at the time each such Restricted Payment is made no Default shall have occurred and be continuing or would result therefrom, (x) in an amount not in excess of (and which shall utilize) the Available Amount at the time such Restricted Payments are made; provided that, the Borrower is at such time in Pro Forma Compliance with the covenant set forth in Section 6.12 after giving effect to such Restricted Payments, and (y) in an unlimited amount if the Total Net Leverage Ratio at the time such Restricted Payments are made, calculated on a Pro Forma Basis giving effect to such Restricted Payments, is equal to or less than 3.50 to 1.00
